title: Survey control points (GCP and independent CHECK points)
description: Data contract for surveyed control. The 'role' field enforces GCP vs CHECK separation. Coordinates must reference an explicit spatial frame (CRS, unit, vertical datum). Per-photo PIXEL observations are stored SEPARATELY (see observations.schema.json) per 05 §2.

crs_id.description: e.g. EPSG:5186 or LOCAL:<name>. Never blank.

role.description: MUST NOT be 'unknown' for real data. 'gcp'/'scale'/'constraint' constrain the model; 'check'/'check_length' are NEVER used in calibration (independent validation only).

measured_sigma.description: Survey measurement uncertainty in frame units (NOT model error).
